summary_en: This trial tests de-escalated (lower-dose) intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT), guided by response to induction chemotherapy, compared with standard IMRT, in patients with EBV-associated nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Both arms receive IMRT once daily, 5 days a week, for up to 7 weeks, as long as there is no disease progression or unacceptable toxicity, and participants also have imaging scans and blood samples. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the listed phase is NA.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia IMRT de dosis reducida (desescalada), guiada por la respuesta a la quimioterapia de inducción, comparada con la IMRT estándar, en pacientes con carcinoma nasofaríngeo asociado al virus de Epstein-Barr. Ambos grupos reciben IMRT una vez al día, 5 días por semana, durante hasta 7 semanas, siempre que no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable; los participantes también se realizan estudios de imagen y toman muestras de sangre. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; la fase aparece como NA.
who_for: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma confirmed by biopsy or cytology.
Detectable EBV DNA in blood plasma.
Stage III to IVA disease with no distant metastasis at diagnosis.
Planning platinum-based induction chemotherapy and platinum-based chemotherapy with IMRT.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or better.
not_for: Prior systemic chemotherapy for nasopharyngeal carcinoma, other than induction chemotherapy.
Prior radiation to the nasopharynx or nearby areas that would overlap the trial radiation fields.
Investigational drug or device use within 4 weeks before the first dose.
Severe active comorbidity, or active untreated infection needing IV antibiotics.
Child-bearing potential without a documented negative pregnancy test.
